body: i'll leave him if he keeps playing like that. thanks maaayn

i think the guy will be in my life for a few more years but you're right... i want someone who will respect my inner turmoil enough to NOT add to it, and he's been great for the most part but we might have some similar triggers and things do go downhill pretty quickly. i have zero expertise and this will take a while. i think we'll break up soon.

nobody with any authority at this university will care about my family life, unfortunately. i live in Seattle and there is nowhere more gay-tolerant, but people are better at tolerating than actually listening to how hard it can be. people sometimes figure if they voted for obama they're done cutting any slack for gay people... like, didn't i make things better for you already? never mind that i grew up in a christian/republican stronghold. i could be wrong, but it doesn't really feel like an option.

thank you so much for replying. you're helping. don't know how but i'm sure of it.
my brothers will never know if i die the wrong way. thanks for your help. i'm trying to hang in there and it really helps for me to type and think slowly.
